scope: One lost-receipt native browser case, preserving real host/socket/storage/locks and replacing host-wall watchdog waiting with actual registered-clock boundary and native receipt/pong completion. No production changes.

environment.isolation: Per-command ordinary-UID user/network namespace; loopback-only addresses/routes verified, setup capabilities dropped before bun run test; BRAIN_REQUIRE_CHROME=1 plus existing offline preload and route guards; shared benchmark lock.
environment.build: Original beforeAll Bun.build browser fixture from checkout source, conditions bun; no existing-built bypass or additional workspace build.
environment.clock: Page clock installed before navigation; host/Bun clock and native storage/socket operations remain real.
environment.resources: Single shared host. CPU is GNU time user+system; max RSS in KiB. Command timing excludes benchmark-lock queue.

proof.identity: Successful same-stack routed client send selects the exact request, captures its actual submission, and later checks matching status/receipt identities; a known callback opens the correlated ping scope. Actual descriptor owner is discovered without changing constructor or prototype chain. Extra same-stack timer registrations fail ambiguity assertions; no delay-only or callback-text classification.
proof.boundary: Independent default 5000 assertion precedes pauseAt(actual registration time + 4999), then no callback/no status/still awaiting; runFor(1) delivers actual callback. Missed deadline fails closed.
proof.nativeCompletion: Same request/submission accepted receipts, original dropped count 2, real Answered state and one backend settlement remain. The candidate checks the rearmed watchdog clear before the matching pong wait, then verifies known ping handle clear and one connected socket. All identity/cancellation checks precede another 5001 logical advance.
proof.wallGuaranteeChange: Original elapsed>=4500 matcher expression retained but input is deliberately logical page time, not host wall. Default registration and before/at behavior now own this guarantee.
proof.clockSemantics: Installed pauseAt coalesces already-due UI/interval callbacks at target; not every display tick is replayed. Owned watchdog remains target+1 and ping/rearm are registered later. No global drain or animation cadence claim.
proof.cleanup: Original descriptors including flags/value restored/read back on actual owners; original context.close nested in finally. No observer cleanup clears timer handles. Failed controls may leave handles pending until context destruction; no fabricated cancellation.
proof.overhead: Synchronous counters, wrappers forwarding the original send and timer callback while preserving this, arguments, return and throw behavior, post-oracle/failure page snapshot and host JSON writes are included. No promise wrapper is added. Extra native polling, when needed, is counted separately.
proof.finalMeasuredDifference: Measured test variants add synchronous setup stopwatch and post-assertion/failure snapshot/file writes; final functional test omits those capture writes. Helper is byte-identical to v4 measured helper.
proof.existingPolicyProof: Existing answer-delivery.test.ts default 5000/4999+1 manager test is unchanged; no duplicate lower-layer policy test added.

ast.scope: Pre-execution source proof; executed outcomes recorded separately below.
ast.conditionalCountCorrection: Static branch-inclusive totals 112/137 include original if(premature) matcher; healthy full totals 111/136 exclude only that unexecuted original branch.
ast.awaitChange: Original openPage await is inlined into its same native actions so page clock installs before goto; original answer/state/receipt/settlement/close awaits retained. Additional boundary/native polling awaits are test-specific.

comparison.limits: Single source-frozen equal-selection full-file pair on a shared host. Target-body reduction is an observed target-specific difference, not an exact causal estimate. Other case variation and setup contribute; no whole-CI savings claim. Old elapsed >=4500 expression now consumes logical page elapsed, explicitly distributed to independent default registration and before/at callback guarantees.

nativeCommandCosts.limits: Native command time only; excludes engineering, static types and benchmark lock queue. Baseline checker correction reused bytes, cost counted once.
